inlines.v: PUD'DER, noun [This is supposed to be the same as pother.] A tumult; a confused noise; bustle. [Vulgar.] PUD'DER, verb intransitive To make a tumult or bustle. PUD'DER, verb transitive To perplex; to embarrass; to confuse; vulgarly to bother.
